pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit sequential entries within 10 minutes or 2 points of an existing position to prevent correlated cascading liquidation (no falling knife or cluster stacking).
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require an ATR-normalized multi-timeframe volume confirmation and zero high-impact macroeconomic news release within +/- 15 minutes before executing any trade.
profit_harvest_threshold: Instantly execute trailing micro-harvest locks via Sentinel Peak once unrealized profit hits +$5.00 to prevent evaporation of floating gains.
